briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate frontier race with new reasoning benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models this month. Regulatory pressure is mounting while compute buildouts accelerate globally. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation emerges as a key protocol innovation amid rising security concerns.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced multimodal chain-of-thought capabilities. Anthropic's Claude 4.5 and Meta's Llama 4.1 compete on agentic tasks. DeepSeek-R2 achieved new open-source SOTA on GPQA. xAI's Grok-3.5 shows gains in real-time reasoning.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime defenses. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 3.2M Blackwell GPUs this quarter. Microsoft announced $45B hyperscale expansion across three continents. TSMC reports 2nm yields supporting next-gen AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level security like dynamic dialects become mandatory for all frontier model deployments by 2028?
